SunwellPlateau:Kalecgos.name: Kalecgos

states.name: asleep
states.look: Lies asleep on the platform until pulled (stand state SLEEP).
states.source: creature_template_addon 24850 bytes1=3; boss_kalecgos.cpp:117 SetStandState(UNIT_STAND_STATE_SLEEP)

states.name: crazed rage (10%)
states.look: Enrages when he or Sathrovarr drops to 10%: Crazed Rage aura, pulses 44806 every 5 s.
states.source: boss_kalecgos.cpp:125-129, 148 (ScheduleHealthCheckEvent 10 -> ACTION_ENRAGE); 5 s period from TBC Anniversary DB2 via wago.tools (branch wow_anniversary) SpellEffect 44807

states.name: banished (1%)
states.look: At 1% he banishes himself and waits; the fight ends only when Sathrovarr is banished too.
states.source: boss_kalecgos.cpp:131-133, 153, 182 (ScheduleHealthCheckEvent 1 -> SPELL_BANISH; win check HasAura(BANISH) && _sathBanished)

SunwellPlateau:Kalecgos.notes: Only attacks targets above z 50, the normal realm (boss_kalecgos.cpp:100-102). Resets if >50 yd from home (CheckInRoom). Spectral Rift (GO 187055, summoned by Spectral Blast 44866 at the targeted player's spot, 15 s) is dynamic, so NOT listed. Force field GO 188421 and collision GOs 188523/188524 are doors (skipped).

SunwellPlateau:Kalecgos.name: Sathrovarr the Corruptor
SunwellPlateau:Kalecgos.why: Spectral-realm boss: the portal team tanks him and gets him to 1% while the dragon team handles Kalecgos.

positions.source: boss_kalecgos.cpp:254 SummonCreature(NPC_SATHROVARR, ...) in the 9 s scheduler after JustEngagedWith

states.name: demonic visual
states.look: Permanent demonic aura visual. He also has Spectral Invisibility (44801), so only players in the spectral realm see him.

states.name: crazed rage (10%)
states.look: Enrages when he or Kalecgos reaches 10%.
states.source: boss_kalecgos.cpp:361-366, 399

states.name: banished (1%)
states.look: Banishes at 1%; together with Kalecgos' banish this ends the fight.
states.source: boss_kalecgos.cpp:373-378, 401

SunwellPlateau:Kalecgos.notes: The spectral realm has the same x/y as the platform but sits ~127.6 yd lower. Teleport: Spectral Realm 46019 lands players at (1704.34, 928.17, -74.558) and Teleport: Normal Realm 46020 sends them back to (1704.34, 928.17, 53.079) (spell_target_position). The Spectral Realm aura 46021 lasts 60 s (DB2 duration index 3) and ends with Spectral Exhaustion + teleport back (boss_kalecgos.cpp:541-544). He only attacks targets below z 50 (boss_kalecgos.cpp:328-330). On success he is moved to (1696.20, 915.0, 53.079) for the RP kill (boss_kalecgos.cpp:220).
